interface.shortDescription: Local-first agent control plane for task tracking, memory, and multi-agent coordination
interface.longDescription: Fulcrum gives Codex persistent task tracking, hybrid semantic memory (FTS5 + vector + graph), structured agent-run lifecycle with heartbeat, role-based agent profiles, team-invoke policy enforcement, and per-session hook-driven guardrails. All data stays on your machine in a local SQLite + vault layout; no cloud control plane.
